style.backgroundSystem: seamless matte studio field #F2F2F3 for product screens alternating with a pure #FFFFFF infographic field; one flat illustrated backdrop disc (#DDEAF0 with #F6E3D5 blocks) is allowed only on the single scene screen
style.iconSystem: single-weight 1.5pt line icons, numbered circles, hairline leader lines with small dot terminals, circular magnifier insets with a hairline ring; used consistently across screens
style.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio light, soft front-left key with a fill bounce card opposite, soft contact shadow grounding every shoe, raking low side light only inside macro insets, 5500K
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: one consistent premium kids-footwear ecommerce visual system across the entire set; fixed palette of matte field #F2F2F3, pure infographic field #FFFFFF, deep charcoal copy #2B2B2B, and one playful accent #F07C4A; neutral 5500K high-key studio lighting with a soft front-left key, fill bounce, and soft contact shadows; one modern rounded geometric sans-serif family with in-image Chinese copy wrapped in 「」; single-weight thin-line icons, numbered circles, hairline leader lines and circular magnifier insets; matte seamless backgrounds only, no reflective table and no repeated floor texture; stable product scale and lateral quarter anchor angle; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no invented colorways beyond the reference product
style.presentationRules: the lateral quarter beauty angle is the anchor view and stays at the same scale across screens; strap, collar and heel pull-tab always readable; hairline section dividers with a centred label; no product edge crops on packshot screens
style.surfaceSystem: matte pale seamless sweep, no wood grain, no fabric, no reflective tabletop, no floor texture repetition
style.typography: one modern rounded geometric sans-serif family; a display headline weight plus a light support weight; Chinese in-image copy always wrapped in 「」; no serif, no handwriting, no retro or novelty lettering
